As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Implements the verify lane mixin, which orchestrates the authoring of independent test suites without access to the implementation (INV-1). Handles oracle suite creation, probe placement, dependency tracking, and patch quality assessment across repair rounds.
